title: Delicate French Chickpea Terine
description: A light and crispy French-inspired terrine made with chickpeas and delicate flavors.

ingredients.name: french bread
ingredients.notes: crust removed and torn into small pieces

instructions: Brush the french bread with olive oil and toast in the oven for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, mash the chickpeas using a fork or a potato masher.
Add the crispy onions, french seasonings, lemon juice, salt, and chopped parsley to the bowl with the chickpeas.
To assemble the terrine, place a layer of toasted bread at the bottom of a 9x5 inch loaf pan.
Top with a layer of the chickpea mixture, followed by another layer of bread.
Repeat this process until all the ingredients have been used, ending with a layer of bread on top.
Cover the terrine with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Slice the terrine and serve chilled.
